image_description: A high-angle close-up shot of three baby bibs arranged in a slightly overlapping pile on a white surface. The top bib is dark blue with a subtle white pattern and pink trim; the middle-left bib is light mint green; the bottom-left bib is solid royal blue. All bibs feature a rounded neck hole and a curved, shield-like body shape typical of infant feeding accessories.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly flat, flexible sheets of material designed to drape over a torso, consistent with the definition.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All three visible bibs exhibit the characteristic truncated shield silhouette, wider at the bottom than the neck opening.

artifact_observations.location: Overlap region between top blue bib and mint green bib
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight blurring and indistinct boundary where the two fabrics meet. The shadow cast by the top bib onto the mint one is very soft and lacks precise contact occlusion, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

artifact_observations.location: Neck hole of the bottom-left royal blue bib
artifact_observations.reasoning: The inner edge of the neck hole appears slightly irregular and 'melted' into the background/fabric rather than having a crisp, stitched hem. The geometry of the hole is not a perfect smooth curve, showing slight wobble typical of AI generation.

artifact_observations.location: Top right edge of the dark blue bib
artifact_observations.reasoning: The edge seems to fade out or merge slightly with the white background without a definitive hard stop, indicating minor edge-bleeding.
